prerequisites: A connected device or running emulator (adb devices shows one)
The mobile app under test is installed on the device/emulator
Local mobile sessions run visibly in the foreground; headless only in explicit CI profiles
rollback: Reset app state on the device after the flow
Terminate the app and restore device to pre-test state

hosts.notes: Device-run evidence is real device behavior; an unavailable device or adb yields explicit UNAVAILABLE evidence, never a silent skip.

notes: Requires a real device/emulator: absence of adb/device is UNAVAILABLE, not PASS.
Visible-application policy: local mobile interaction opens the real app in the foreground.
